answer: Keep sybil resistance practical by isolating unproven agents in a shallow lagoon of limited privileges until they prepay a sable-dark bond and collect attestations from already established peers. Only then does an agent get a page in the community atlas of voters. Mass-created identities can splash into the lagoon cheaply, but they cannot redraw the atlas without paying and waiting. That pricing turns a flood of sockpuppets into a money pit, while long-lived agents retain their mapped influence.
